descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S12 「电脑改东西时手机离线或在后台，然后回来」 Phone offline or in the background while the computer changes things, then back

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry.（UAT TC-25 step 2；UAT TC-25；TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh.（TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital.（UAT TC-25 step 6；UAT TC-25；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Both devices signed in; the phone on the Hospital list

When The phone's Convex socket is cut and the phone goes offline and hidden for 30 s; meanwhile the computer adds a patient and changes {hospitalPatient}'s room; then the phone comes back online and visible. Run in both modes

Then While cut off the phone does not show the changes (proof that it really was cut off). Without a reload or a tap, it then catches up: the new card and the new room show, and the old room is gone. The phone makes no write while offline (offline queuing is After Pilot)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Scripted. Before reconnecting: the phone page must NOT show 'QA Sync Offline' or '6D-30'; if either is visible, or the WebSocket was never seen to close, the run is invalid (not Pass): context.setOffline alone is not known to close an open Convex socket, and dispatching visibilitychange does not change document.visibilityState. …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S12

Phone offline or in the background while the computer changes things, then back

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：sync-probe both modes: phone context's Convex socket closed and refused (routeWebSocket), setOffline, visibilityState hidden; computer adds through its form and changes room/unit; after 30 s the phone must not show either (else invalid); restore: phone shows both without reload, old room gone, no sign-in/error; mutations around the cut recorded. — multi-session, fault-offline and browser-events are all Playwright features.

Detail:

Both modes: phone socket closed (0 open) and refused, offline, hidden; after 30 s it showed neither change (valid cut); back online/visible it showed the new card in ~0.55 s and the new room at once, old room gone, no sign-in/error, no reload; no write while cut. Observation (needs-human): the computer's NH add of 'QA Sync Resident Offline' got 'QA Sync Resident 56073 is already in the resident panel. Add as a separate resident anyway?' (different name).

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — sync-probe (our scripted two-context runner, not written yet) gives each context its own email-code session through createAuthSession (seed:issueTestOtp, local admin key); on dev the runner never signs in (only Quinn's dev-login does) and has no admin key, so as designed it runs on the local stac…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
